subject: Shiny web scrape app breaks down after second table from website is called

messages.author: 0617777d7b4a6cbb
messages.subject: Shiny web scrape app breaks down after second table from website is called
parts:
I built an app out of a function I found to get data from NOAA, which is great because NOAA limits the amount of data you can call at a a single time. It works great in R and in my app, but returns an error if I try to do more than the time limit set by NOAA, basically making the app not very useful, because my coworkers could just go to NOAA to get that amount of data at a time.

The error I receive is:

 incomplete final line found by readTableHeader on 'http://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/datagetter?product=water_level&application=NOS.COOPS.TAC.WL&begin_date=20130101&end_date=20130201&datum=NAVD&station=9439040&time_zone=LST&units=english&format=csv'
Error in seq.int(0, to0 - from, by) : 'to' cannot be NA, NaN or infinite

I had trouble getting the table to render at first because the time data was in POSIX, but someone was able to point me to a fix for that.  I cannot figure out what to do about this error.

I have attached my files.  If anyone can point me in the right direction I would appreciate it.

Jeff
